mapper.sql: select reminder_id, cat_id, reminder_type, title, content, remind_date, status, target_user, read_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from cat_reminder

select c.reminder_id, c.cat_id, c.reminder_type, c.title, c.content, c.remind_date, case when r.read_id is not null then '1' else '0' end as status, c.target_user, r.read_time, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, c.remark from cat_reminder c left join cat_reminder_read r on r.reminder_id = c.reminder_id and r.user_id = ifnull(#{currentUserId}, 0)
mapper.select: order by (case when r.read_id is null then 0 else 1 end), c.remind_date desc, c.reminder_id desc limit #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert into cat_reminder ( cat_id, reminder_type, title, content, remind_date, status, target_user, read_time, create_by, create_time )values( #{catId}, #{reminderType}, #{title}, #{content}, #{remindDate}, #{status}, #{targetUser}, #{readTime}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.delete: delete from cat_reminder where reminder_id in #{id}
mapper.insert: insert ignore into cat_reminder_read (reminder_id, user_id, read_time) values (#{reminderId}, #{userId}, sysdate())
insert ignore into cat_reminder_read (reminder_id, user_id, read_time) values (#{rid}, #{userId}, sysdate())
mapper.delete: delete from cat_reminder_read where reminder_id in #{id}
mapper.select: select distinct u.user_name from sys_user u inner join sys_user_post up on up.user_id = u.user_id inner join sys_post p on p.post_id = up.post_id where u.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0' and p.post_name in #{name} order by u.user_name
